name: Glass Tank Hall
mood: A cathedral of glass: four great tanks in four colours, humming, with the bright stillness of something drained and kept

poi.title: Draining Log
lines: Log: red, tenth of a litre. Yellow, tenth of a litre. Purple, tenth. Green, tenth. Repeat, repeat, repeat. The handwriting does not change in ten years, which is somehow the worst part.

poi.title: Intercom
lines: Attention. This is a routine announcement. Please remain calm. The hall is monitored. You are being monitored very gently.
The Chief Path-ologist will see you shortly. He sees everyone shortly. It has been a long, short time.

poi.title: Under the Tanks
lines: The four lights fall across the floor and cross in the middle, and where they cross they make a plain white, as if all of it was one thing, once.

exits.label: The Path-ology Lab
exits.body: Below the tanks the stairs go down into the Lab proper. The place is far deadlier than the castle, and nothing heals between fights except the one quiet room near the end. Go down?
